title: 1637 Prairie's basement lights, and its stoop meets the drawn fence post
items: Under 1637 Prairie's swell bay a barred basement light now stands, nearly a storey tall at the walk, as the engraving of the remodel draws it.
Under its wing, two round-headed basement lights stand behind the iron fence.
The front stoop is steeper and shorter: its foot now lands where the engraving draws it, at the fence's first post, instead of 0.75 m further out.
